name: Crawfish River
blurb: Crawfish River in Wisconsin between Wisconsin DNR-listed public accesses.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Markers identify agency-listed access; the map states whether a landing or an approximate facility area has been reviewed. Mileage is preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry; it is not a surveyed paddling route. Difficulty has not been independently rated for every section. Check current conditions, hazards and access with the managing agency before paddling.
sections.accessReview: Dam crossing/portage unresolved: Udeys. A legal, usable route around the barrier has not been established. Do not plan this as a continuous float.
sections.routeReview: This section includes Udeys and needs a closer check of the landing or portage. Consult the agency guide and signed access; do not assume you can paddle through a dam.

sections.routeReview: A signed portage is required at Danville Dam. The access-area map is available, but no continuous dotted path is drawn across the dam.

notices.title: Danville Dam portage required
notices.text: Dodge County describes a marked portage at Danville Dam and notes that it is close to the spillway. Locate the signed take-out before approaching the dam and carry around it. Check current access and conditions with the county before launching.
